data_fields.name: proportional_scalar
data_fields.donor_constant: must be > 0 and != 1; value multiplies inherited number

data_fields.name: relative_adder
data_fields.donor_constant: any number, added to inherited number

data_fields.name: retry_passes
data_fields.donor_constant: no cap; stops when a pass makes no progress

best_idea: Let a content row copy a base row by id and override only a few numbers with a multiplier or an adder, load rows in any order by retrying until a pass makes no progress, and reject any unknown key at load time.
decision_why: Copy-from with proportional and relative deltas fits 100+ legends that differ by a few numbers; the retry loader and strict keys catch order and typo errors at save. Reject mod-set global options because balance numbers must be server-owned rows.
acceptance: A legend row copies a base and sets proportional hp 1.2; the preview shows 1.2x the base hp before publish. A typo key is refused at save with 'unknown field', and a missing base id is named in the error (server test: loadRows() applies the delta, resolves a row listed before its base, and returns an error for an unknown key).
